speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Since Independence, we have pursued our vision of a liveable and sustainable Singapore, balancing environmental protection and economic growth.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Today, we enjoy a clean environment, flowing taps and vibrant green and blue spaces.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources (MEWR) will build on the legacy of our Pioneers and stay true to their spirit of innovation, as we tackle the effects of climate change and current environmental challenges.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As a low-lying island state, Singapore is especially vulnerable to its impact.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to advocate for and contribute to global climate action.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will undertake our Voluntary National Review of the Sustainable Development Goals at the United Nations in July 2018.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To rally the region, we will organise the Special Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Ministerial Meeting on Climate Action (SAMCA) and Expanded SAMCA (E-SAMCA) in July 2018.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The 2016 Climate Action Plan sets out our adaptation measures to build Singapore’s resilience to climate change, and our mitigation measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in every sector.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In this Year of Climate Action and beyond, we will encourage and support businesses and communities to reduce our carbon footprint and promote sustainable living and working.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to invest in climate-resilient infrastructure, such as enhancing stormwater management systems and diversifying our water supply with more desalination and NEWater plants.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In tandem, we are pursuing better management of our water demand.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also deepen our local research capabilities on climate science and weather through the Centre for Climate Research Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Using resources efficiently is critical to reducing emissions, limiting pollution and strengthening Singapore’s economic resilience.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will strive to become a Zero Waste nation and extract greater value from waste as a resource, so as to achieve our vision of a circular economy.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Just as we have closed the water loop by recycling water endlessly, we should similarly strive towards closing the waste loop.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are working towards the reuse of incineration bottom ash to extend the lifespan of Semakau Landfill.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: At the same time, we need to kindle in Singaporeans a national consciousness towards the environment, where everyone takes individual and collective responsibility and plays a part through practising sustainable consumption and recycling at home.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As our population and economy grow, the demands on our infrastructure will increase, even as our manpower and resource constraints tighten.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We must transform our environmental services industry and workforce through technology and innovation to support our move towards greater carbon and resource efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The upcoming Tuas Water Reclamation Plant and the Integrated Waste Management Facility, the first in the world, will be our signature innovation platform to reap synergies from the water-energy-waste nexus.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Effluent water from wastewater treatment will be used for cooling waste incineration equipment; food waste will be co-digested with used water sludge to enhance biogas production to increase the overall plant thermal efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are stepping up research and development and improving resource efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: For instance, the Waste-to-Energy Research Facility, the first of its kind in Singapore, will enable the transition of emerging technologies, such as turning waste and biomass into synthetic gas, from research into demonstration and test-bedding projects.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To enhance energy efficiency in water treatment, we are leading research in technologies, such as anaerobic membrane bioreactors for used water treatment, and electro-deionisation and biomimicry for desalinated water.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To expand the use of solar energy, we are tapping reservoir surface space and piloting a floating solar system at Tengeh Reservoir.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To better serve the public, we are leveraging smart technologies, such as sensors and other digital technologies.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are conducting trials on the Automated Meter Reading system to provide timely water consumption data to help households save water.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will provide opportunities for technology collaboration and adaptation across the environmental services industry.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As part of the Environmental Services Industry Transformation Map to ensure a vibrant, sustainable and professional cleaning and waste management industry, we are embracing the use of automation, robotics and data analytics to enhance productivity in the industry.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Besides new public housing estates, the pneumatic waste conveyance systems are being implemented in new private residential developments with at least 500 dwelling units.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Increasingly, we will use technology to remotely manage waste collection, and robotics to sort recyclables at materials recovery facilities.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The use of autonomous cleaning equipment will free workers to focus on higher value work.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The future of delivering environmental services will provide an exciting array of green jobs for our people.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As we strive to build a liveable and sustainable Singapore, we will continue to integrate and transform our blue and green spaces.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through the Active, Beautiful, Clean (ABC) Waters programme, we will continue to turn concrete drains, canals and reservoirs into vibrant and beautiful rivers, streams and lakes.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: While the Government will continue to strengthen our regulatory regime to safeguard our environment and public health, creating a liveable and endearing home ultimately depends on everyone taking ownership of our environment.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through the Sustainable Singapore movement, we will continue to rally Singaporeans, the larger community and industry partners to realise this shared vision.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our hawker centres are an important hub for social interaction and an integral part of our daily life and national identity.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Beyond providing affordable and good food, our hawker centres are important community spaces that bring together people from all walks of life and help to strengthen the bonds of our multiracial society.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to invest in developing and enhancing our hawker centres to ensure that future generations continue to enjoy our unique and vibrant hawker culture.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our Pioneers have laid a solid foundation and left us this wonderful City in a Garden.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work together to build on their precious legacy, and leave our children with a smart, green and liveable home.
